cases.title: Square
cases.note: A geometric 4 × 4 square becomes an inclusive 5 × 5 mask in Supervision.

cases.title: Thin rectangle
cases.note: A single extra column has a large effect on a one-pixel-wide object.

cases.title: Diagonal triangle
cases.note: Different edge rules also change the staircase along a diagonal.

cases.title: Slanted polygon
cases.note: The larger mask can still miss a COCO pixel. The difference is not a uniform expansion.

cases.title: Subpixel sliver
cases.note: Rounding collapses this polygon to a line; inclusive drawing still marks pixels. COCO initially marks none.

cases.title: Disjoint squares
cases.note: Each component accumulates its own boundary differences.

cases.title: Half-pixel ties
cases.note: NumPy rounds exact halves to even. Here the extra pixels are on the top and left.
